# Ballast

> Ballast Research LLC is a research, development and media distribution company in Los Angeles. We find what sells, put the money behind it, and keep the customers it brings. We run paid media, creative, creator programs and measurement for brands in health and wellness, sports, streaming and entertainment, retail and open finance.

## Results we can state
- $50M+ in managed paid media, peaking at $2M+ a month at 4x blended ROAS for Toyota, Starbucks and STARZPLAY
- 6x peak ROAS for a DTC client
- $1.2M+ in monthly sales for a health and wellness brand
- 30+ UGC creators onboarded and paid on sales
- $5K a day in sales from TikTok LIVE selling
- Paid media, creative and distribution for Netflix, Disney, Peacock, Universal, STARZPLAY, Starbucks, Toyota, LG, BMW, NEAR and SailGP

## Services
- Media strategy and planning: annual, quarterly and in-flight plans tied to sales and brand goals
- Paid media execution across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, programmatic and CTV, reported against revenue
- Live shopping: TikTok LIVE selling, including the shop, hosts, offers and schedule
- UGC and creator campaigns: creators recruited, briefed and paid on sales
- Measurement: one number per goal, reconciled to real orders, with tests that show what spend creates
- Creative: ads, product imagery and AI production made for each platform and built to pass review
- Regulated categories: health, telehealth, weight loss, supplements and open finance, with compliance built into accounts and creative
- Agency and team oversight: agencies, creators and vendors held to scope, cost and results
- Audience research: who buys, where demand exists and what moves them, including fans and creators in sport

## Pricing
From $3.5K to $100K depending on scope. An audit or a two-week sprint sits at the low end; ongoing media and creative run higher. Clients keep everything we build.

## Who we're a fit for
- DTC health, wellness and supplement brands that want to grow on TikTok and Meta without losing their ad accounts
- Brands in regulated or restricted categories, including research-use-only products, that other agencies turn away
- Early-stage brands that need paid media, creative and a creator program from one team, starting with a small ad budget
- Brands that want spend reported against real revenue instead of platform-reported results
- Sports teams, leagues and fan platforms that want to understand and reach their fans

## How engagements work
- Most clients start with a 90-day pilot, then go month to month with 30 days' notice
- A deposit at signing starts the work and is applied to the first month
- Ad spend is paid directly to the platforms
- Clients own their ad accounts, pages, data and the creative they pay for
- Weekly reporting and a monthly strategy call

## Common questions
Q: Can you run ads for supplements or research-use-only products without getting accounts banned?
A: Yes. We write claims and creative to each platform's policy, avoid human-use and dosing claims for research-use-only products, and keep accounts in good standing. No one can guarantee platform approvals, but staying live in restricted categories is our specialty.

Q: Do you work with small or early-stage brands?
A: Yes. We often start brands on TikTok with a few thousand dollars a month in ad spend, then add Meta and more creative as winners emerge.

Q: How do you measure results?
A: Against real orders and revenue, not the numbers ad platforms report. We reconcile platform reporting to the store and judge spend on what it actually created.

Q: Do you write the creative yourselves?
A: Yes. The founder is a copywriter as well as a media buyer and writes the concepts, scripts and ad copy we run.

## Writing
- [Your ad platform is overcounting your sales](https://ballast.la/notes/your-ad-platform-is-overcounting-your-sales/): why an ad platform claimed more than twice the sales a DTC store could prove, and a ten-minute check for your own account
